title: Third US aircraft carrier arrives in Middle East amid tensions with Iran
html:
Third US aircraft carrier arrives in Middle East amid tensions with Iran

Trump shares a message saying: ‘May God protect our troops’ as the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrives in the region and joins the two US carriers already in the area, amid tensions with Iran and reported Iranian attacks on US-linked sites in Bahrain.
summary: Trump shares a message saying: ‘May God protect our troops’ as the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrives in the Middle East.
